models.title: John3Doe v1.0 - human head
models.description: Head model by Ana de Oliveira Rodrigues (2006): 151 x 259 x 259 cubes of 1.86 x 1.11 x 1.11 mm, 19 tissues. Add a phone with Tools → Place Dipole Antenna; the EH calculation of the whole head needs about 2.6 GB (Tools → Redux Model for 8x less).

models.title: Cube_5_21_21_21 - steel cube
models.description: 5 x 5 x 5 steel cubes (1 cm) in air. The April/2007 validation case of the temperature calculation (Tenv = 90, hc = 115, Ttissues = 450; then with radiation off, which since 2008 means giving the steel emissivity 0).

models.title: Cube_21_21_21 - one steel cube
models.description: A single 5 cm steel cube in a 21 x 21 x 21 domain.

models.title: Air_21_21_21 - empty space
models.description: 21 x 21 x 21 cubes of air with a point source in the centre: the 2006 test case of the EH calculation (Readme: 'abra e rode o caso de teste').

models.title: Air_SmallHead - a tiny head
models.description: 21 x 21 x 21 cubes with the deltas of the head model and a few cubes of skin, hair, bone, CSF and fat: a quick test for both calculations.
